title: `--experimental-enable-aws-session-cache` removed — a controller still passing it fails to start

detection.reason: checked in the ESO controller's container args only (Deployment) — a flag set another way is not scanned

remediation: Remove `--experimental-enable-aws-session-cache` from the controller args (Helm: `extraArgs`) before upgrading to 1.3.2 or later; the flag is no longer registered and the controller exits with "unknown flag".
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)(external-secrets/external-secrets|bitnami/external-secrets)([:@]|$)"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)" as $w | [.spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]?] | map(select(test("aws-session-cache"))) | select(length != 0) | "\($w) \(join(" "))"'  # each row still passes the removed flag
